subject: MAP & dataset exchange: leased test corpus, sandbox access and usage constraints
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma@ekoretail.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval dataset swap — initial ask and timeline

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to run a short POC that exercises our search-and-ranking prompts against your retrieval-augmented generator. To do that we need two things from Redwood: (1) a short-term lease of a curated test corpus (~15k examples) and (2) a sandbox endpoint with token limits and guaranteed isolation for two weeks.

High level constraints from our side:
- Dataset must be available under a strict non-production license and cannot be used for model training.
- We need masking guidance for any PII present in shared testcases.
- Sandbox must preserve KV cache isolation and not access customer production keys.

Target timeline: kickoff next Monday (2026-04-12), full POC complete by 2026-04-26. Can Redwood provide a draft MAP and sample licensing language we can run by procurement?

Oliver (cc'ed) will handle procurement questions. Looking forward — Emma

Emma Lopez
Head of Product, EkoRetail
emma@ekoretail.com
+1 415-555-0122

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@ekoretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Oliver Grant <oliver@ekoretail.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval dataset swap — initial ask and timeline

Hi Emma — great to hear and glad the demo was useful.

Quick answer up front: yes, we can do a two-week sandbox + leased test corpus under a short-term data lease with non-training restrictions. I've attached a draft MAP and one small sample package (15 sample testcases) so your team can validate the format.

Key items we propose in the MAP:
- Dataset lease window: 14 days from sandbox activation.
- Usage constraints: evaluation-only; no retention beyond lease period; no model training or benchmarking that publishes the raw dataset.
- Masking checklist: Redwood will run automated PII redaction and provide a masking report; customer can request additional manual redaction within 48 hours.
- Sandbox: dedicated VPC segment, ephemeral API key, KV cache isolation; request limits capped at 10 concurrent requests and 10k tokens/minute unless we agree to a temporary increase.
- Audit: access logs will be retained for 90 days and shared as part of the MAP close.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Your procurement reviews the attached MAP draft and sends redlines (we can iterate quickly).
2) We provision the sandbox (pre-prod credentials) by 2026-04-10 for internal integration tests.
3) Formal activation (lease start) on 2026-04-12.

I've looped in Marcus (security/compliance) and Kim (solutions) to handle the technical and redline work. Marcus/Kim — can you confirm the masking report cadence and whether the 90-day logs retention is OK?

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
Tessa_Morgan@redwood.ai
Attachment: MAP-draft-EkoRetail-2026-04-06.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Oliver Grant <oliver@ekoretail.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval dataset swap — initial ask and timeline

Tessa / Emma — quick security note from our side:

- Masking: automated PII scan + redact will be run as a first pass; we will deliver a PDF masking report listing types and counts of redactions within 48 hours of dataset handoff. If EkoRetail requests manual review we estimate 2 business days for a prioritized batch (we will include an SLA clause).
- Data handling: the leased corpus will be stored on an access-controlled bucket with object-level encryption; no copies retained outside the lease window. We will provide immutable audit logs for access requests.
- Sandbox isolation: the pre-prod environment uses a separate Redis instance for KV cache; we confirm there is no cross-tenant key persistence.

One ask: to accelerate provisioning we need a signed nonce (simple one-page data-lease acceptance) from procurement confirming evaluation-only use and the requested start/end dates. I can draft the nonce if you want.

Marcus Lin
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Tessa / Marcus / Kim — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft MAP. Procurement reviewed the draft and signed the one-page acceptance (attached). A couple of clarifications they requested: 

- Can Redwood add a short paragraph explicitly prohibiting derivative dataset creation or redistribution to third parties?
- We want the masking report to include a redaction sample (3 examples) so our privacy office can validate the process without seeing the full data.
- Is there a way to temporarily raise the token cap to 15k tokens/minute during the first 48 hours of the POC for load testing? We understood the default limit is 10k.

If those are acceptable we can proceed with the sandbox activation on 2026-04-12 as planned. Attached: signed_data_lease_nonce.pdf, procurement-comments.docx.
